title: Laddu and Chintu, the Bug Detectives!
moral: Be gentle and say hello, and even a tiny bug can become a big new friend.
description: Chintu has a brand-new magnifying glass, and Laddu is a teeny bit scared of creepy-crawlies! Join Laddu, Chintu, Pinky, Dadaji and Golu the goat as they hunt for insects in Masti Nagar, count legs, and meet a very special spotty friend. Learn that insects have six legs in this funny animated story for kids aged 3 to 8.
intro: Hi friends! Welcome to Little Lantern Stories! Today's story is... Laddu and Chintu, the Bug Detectives! Get your magnifying glass ready!
outro: The End! Remember, friends: be gentle and say hello, and even a tiny bug can become a big new friend. And Golu says... Ba-a-a-a! That means: this notebook is yummy! See you tomorrow... bye-bye!
